changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: Sub-contract status is now held to draft, active, onHold, completed, terminated and expired (#863). The web form used to offer inactive and suspended, which the list badge had no entry for; both meant the contract was paused, so they become onHold. Any other stored value is left as it is: the web falls back to active for a value it does not know, and the next save from the form writes a valid one. Re-runnable.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE sub_contract SET status = 'onHold' WHERE status IN ('inactive', 'suspended');

rollback.comment: The original inactive or suspended value is not recorded, so nothing is restored.
